Step: 1643 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 1643-10-12:  
October: 31 - 12 = 19 days used, so 95 - 19 = 76 days left.  
November: 30 days → 76 - 30 = 46 days left.  
December: 31 days → 46 - 31 = 15 days left.  
Remaining 15 days go into January 1644 → 1644-01-15.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1644-01-15
